guides.name: Sorcerer PvP by player data — AION 2 META

$join.$t: PvP-гайд из интернета, не с Questlog: {site}, автор {author}. Собран помощником по статье — сверяйтесь с оригиналом.

$join: A data-driven fan site that builds its advice from what ranked Sorcerers actually run. For PvP it raises Hellfire, Bittercold Wind, Firestorm and Winter's Shackles to 20 with PvP-specific specialties, tags Arctic Armor, Glacial Smite and Hibernation as PvP stigmas, and shows the usual opening path on the Azphel PvP board. Its stat order is taken from PvE rankings, so treat the stat weights as a rough guide.

goals.description: The usual first 12 nodes on the PvP board (opens at level 45): HP, PvP Attack, Status Effect Resist, PvP Defense, MP, PvP Accuracy/Evasion, PvP Crit Resist, PvP Attack, PvP Damage Boost, then MP, PvP Attack, Status Effect Resist.

titles.notes: Most used by Sorcerers on the page. The two Wings titles (PvP Damage Boost, PvP Attack, PvP Accuracy) are faction-specific.

tips.title: Freeze, then burst
tips.text: Frost has roughly a 50% freeze chance and Frost Burst only hits frozen targets, so fire Frost Burst right after a freeze lands.

tips.title: Keep melee off you
tips.text: Bittercold Wind roots and Winter's Shackles slows. Together they are your main tools to hold melee classes at range.

tips.title: Anti-heal and isolation
tips.text: Firestorm's specialty 3 cuts incoming healing by 60% for 5s. Curse: Tree takes one player out for 10s and lowers their Fire Tolerance, but any hit breaks it.

tips.title: Azphel is the PvP board
tips.text: Azphel opens at level 45. The common opening path walks right through PvP stats to the first PvP Damage Boost node, then fills HP/MP and Status Effect Resist near the start.

tips.title: Upgrade order
tips.text: Finish the max-level dungeon set, then the main weapon, Critical Hit, PvE/PvP damage amplification, then bonus stats, Daevanion, Arcana and titles.

guides.name: Sorcerer PvP control — GamerBlurb

$join.$t: PvP-гайд из интернета, не с Questlog: {site}, автор {author}. Собран помощником по статье — сверяйтесь с оригиналом.

$join: A control-first PvP plan: make distance and lock the target with Ice Chain, Bittercold Wind and Frost, isolate a second enemy with Curse: Tree, and spend Hellfire only when the opponent cannot punish the cast. Stigmas lean defensive (Arctic Armor, Hibernation), and stats start with Accuracy, then PvP damage and bulk.

tips.title: Respect enemy Tenacity
tips.text: After an opponent pops their stun-break, your freezes and roots will not stick. Kite and wait for Tenacity to fade before the next control.

tips.title: Hellfire is a punish, not an opener
tips.text: Standing still to cast Hellfire is the riskiest moment for a Sorcerer. Spend it only after control lands or the enemy has used their escapes.

tips.title: Separate PvP stigma set
tips.text: For PvP the guide swaps to Element Enhancement for damage, Arctic Armor and Hibernation for survival, and Curse: Tree to split one enemy off.

tips.title: Accuracy before damage
tips.text: Hits and control must land on players first. Then PvP damage, then bulk (HP, PvP Damage Tolerance), Status Effect Resist, Combat Speed and MP.

guides.name: Sorcerer Arena control — ExpCarry

$join.$t: PvP-гайд из интернета, не с Questlog: {site}, автор {author}. Собран помощником по статье — сверяйтесь с оригиналом.

$join: Arena-focused advice with three stigma sets (control, shield and Abyss group) and a clear lean toward survivability for solo play. Never open with Hellfire: make melee burn their gap-closers, land control first, and keep defensives and control on manual keys. Keep MP high for Arctic Armor and Grace of Enhancement.

rotation: Keep distance and make melee spend their gap-closers before using your strongest control.
Do not open with Hellfire: land control or force an escape first.
Do not burn every defensive at once — save Hibernation for real danger.
Against ranged classes, play line of sight and cooldowns, and pressure with faster skills first.
In the Abyss, stay behind your frontline and hold defensives for target switches.

tips.title: Manual keys in Arena
tips.text: Keep Hibernation, Soul Freeze, Curse: Tree, shields and burst on their own keys instead of a combo macro, so you choose the moment.

tips.title: Survivability for solo Arena
tips.text: A glass cannon can work in a coordinated group, but solo Arena players usually do better with HP, PvP Damage Tolerance and resistances.

tips.title: Three stigma sets
tips.text: Arena control: Element Enhancement, Hibernation, Curse: Tree or Soul Freeze, Arctic Armor. Arena shield: Steel Barrier instead of Arctic Armor. Abyss group: Element Enhancement, Fire Wall, Cold Storm plus one defensive. Stigmas cannot be swapped mid-fight.

tips.title: Keep MP up
tips.text: Arctic Armor's Magic Displacement needs 50%+ MP and Grace of Enhancement needs 25%+ MP, so MP matters more than it looks.
